The '''Colonial Government Pressure''' was the seat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. The [[pressure]] housed two thousand personnel, mainly [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]], and was the home of [[Colonial Governor]] [[Marsh Limoth]], his wife, [[Hola Limoth|Hola]], and their two children. A detachment of twenty-four [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] guarded the facility.
